name: std::basic_string<CharT,Traits,Allocator>::at
intro: Returns a reference to the character at specified location pos. Bounds checking is performed, exception of type std::out_of_range will be thrown on invalid access.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
pos

 -

 position of the character to return

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.text:
Throws std::out_of_range if pos >= size().

If an exception is thrown for any reason, these functions have no effect (strong exception safety guarantee).

examples.output:
abx
string size = 3
string capacity = 7
